title.narrative: NIHR Global Health Research Independent Scientific Advisory Group

description.narrative: The Independent Scientific Advisory Group (ISAG) provides rigorous independent strategic and scientific advice on the development of the National Institute for Health and Care Research’s (NIHR) Global Health Research (GHR) Portfolio. The ISAG aims to ensure that the GHR Portfolio’s programmes, partnerships, and strategy remain coherent, but is not a decision making body. This group meets approximately twice per year and is comprised of approximately 10-15 members and 3-5 observers.

The National Institute of Health and Social Care’s (NIHR) Global Health Research (GHR) Independent Scientific Advisory Group has four main objectives: 1. To provide a scientific sounding board function for the development of new GHR programmes and partnerships. 2. To provide a strategic steer on priorities and focus for the GHR Portfolio. 3. To provide advice on topic refinement and prioritisation for thematic NIHR GHR programmes. 4. To provide advice on promoting coordination and coherence within the GHR Portfolio and in relation to the wider global health research funding landscape.
